name: Bun cha
summary: Bun cha is Hanoi’s chargrilled pork belly and pork patties with rice noodles and herbs. It is almost only a lunch dish. One city page calls the sauce a diluted vinegar fish sauce. Another calls it a hot, sweet broth.
origin: Hanoi. You will find copies elsewhere; eat it here.
howToEat: The pork arrives in the bowl. Put the noodles in with the herbs.
The city’s dish list calls the sauce a diluted vinegar fish sauce. The longer Hanoi food page calls the same bowl a hot, sweet broth.
Nem, the fried roll, is optional.
where: In Hanoi, eat it at lunch around Cua Dong.
priceBand: A lunch set is an everyday restaurant price, not a tasting-menu price.
seoTitle: Bun cha — Hanoi grilled pork and noodles
seoDescription: What bun cha is, how to eat it, and why Hanoi is the place to order it.
